{{Top|leg}}
'''Mah Dala''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital city]] of [[Gobindi]], and it had the greatest concentration of pyramids and ziggurats on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] because there was a plague underneath them; the Gobindi people built the ziggurats to prevent the plague from spreading. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] performed secret experiments with biological weapons here.
